snippet.title: New Gameplay Reveal Trailer | Honor of Kings: World
snippet.description:
What is Honor of Kings: World to you?
The clash of Red Buff and Blue Buff? Heroes stepping out of the Hero's Gorge to join your adventure?

Our producer takes the stage for the first time, unveiling the intricate world of our game. Dive into the secrets of our combat system and catch a glimpse of some new multiplayer content. This world is yours to shape—share your ideas and let's build it together!

Our official website: https://honorofkingsworld.com/
